prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for the issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the 3rd and or 4th respondents de-freeze the bank account No. 332501110050000 of the petitioner company maintained with them.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— After arguing for some time, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the writ petition.

2. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with a liberty to work out the remedy in accordance with law. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
